name: 90638 · La Mirada, CA
findings: ZIP 90638 (La Mirada) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90638 (La Mirada) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
